import "join"
import "strings"

bucket = "cpms"
window = 15m

load =
  from(bucket: bucket)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "chiller")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "estimatedLoadRt")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      deviceId: r.deviceId,
      loadRt: r._value,
    }))
    |> group()


power =
  from(bucket: bucket)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "power")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.category == "chiller")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "totalPower")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      chillerId: r.deviceId,
      loadId: r.deviceId,
      powerKw: r._value,
    }))
    //|> group(columns: ["deviceId"])
    |> group()

running =
  from(bucket: bucket)
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "status")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.deviceId =~ /chiller\d/)
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value == 2 then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
    |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value > 10)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      chillerId: r.deviceId,
      running: r._value,
    }))
    |> group()

loadPower =
  join.inner(
    left: load,
    right: power,
    on: (l, r) => l._time == r._time and l.deviceId == r.loadId,
    as: (l, r) => ({
      _time: l._time,
      chillerId: r.chillerId,
      loadRt: l.loadRt,
      powerKw: r.powerKw,
    }),
  )

join.inner(
  left: loadPower,
  right: running,
  on: (l, r) => l._time == r._time and l.chillerId == r.chillerId,
  as: (l, r) => ({
    _field: l.chillerId,
    loadRt: l.loadRt,
    _value: if l.loadRt > 0.0 then l.powerKw / l.loadRt else 0.0,
  }),
)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.loadRt > 0.0 and r._value > 0.0)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["loadRt"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "evapLWT" or r._field == "condLWT")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "evapLWT", "condLWT"])
        |> group()

compressors =
    from(bucket: "cpms")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "compressor" and r.chillerId == chillerId)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "evapSatTemp" or r._field == "condSatTemp")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "deviceId"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "deviceId", "evapSatTemp", "condSatTemp"])
        |> group()  
  
joined =
    join(tables: {water: water, compressor: compressors}, on: ["_time"])

evapApproach =
    joined
        |> map(
            fn: (r) => ({
                _time: r._time,
                deviceId: r.deviceId,
                _field: "Evap Approach",
                _value: r.evapLWT - r.evapSatTemp,
            })
        )
        |> group(columns: ["deviceId"])

avgApproach = evapApproach
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: ${chartInterval}, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
    |> set(key: "deviceId", value: "avg")


union(tables: [evapApproach, avgApproach])
    |> group(columns: ["deviceId"])
